m: Acts leading to death or intending to cause death (ICCS 01; police-recorded offences)

problems: By province ZIMSTAT publishes only the ICCS 01 aggregate ('acts leading to death or intending to cause death'), which mixes intentional homicide, attempts and non-intentional homicide; the split (e.g. Q1 2026: intentional homicide 306, attempted 320, non-intentional 444) is national only. Policing provinces matched by name to the 10 administrative provinces. Older quarterly reports (2023 Q2/Q3, 2024 Q1) found by web search returned 404; 2024 Q2/Q3 and 2025 Q3 reports are not linked on the ZIMSTAT crime page.
